messages:
maria: Heads up — after last night's KMS alias rotation a bunch of SCIM provisioning calls started failing (401/403). I'm seeing KMS decrypt errors in the worker logs. Pinging @aj @sam-sre for visibility.

aj: can you paste the exact error lines?

maria: Logs from scim-worker-3 at 03:12 UTC:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:04Z ERROR scim-worker KMS Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: Ciphertext references unknown key
caused by: ReEncryptFrom failed
HTTP 401 provisioning: token_verification failed: signature invalid
```

sam-sre: that InvalidCiphertextException usually means the alias now points at a different key id. did we rotate and update alias? run:
```
aws kms list-aliases --region us-west-2 --query "Aliases[?AliasName=='alias/workspace-scim']"
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/workspace-scim
```

maria: ran list-aliases — alias/workspace-scim -> arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/abcd-NEWKEY
previous key id was abcd-OLDKEY (we rotated last night per change log)

lina-sec: also check CloudTrail for ReEncrypt/Decrypt failures around 03:00-03:15 UTC — want to confirm who/what did the alias swap and whether grants were preserved.

maria: cloudtrail snippet:
```
{ eventTime: "2026-03-18T03:01:11Z", eventName: "UpdateAlias", userIdentity: { type: "IAMUser", arn: "arn:aws:iam::1111:user/deployment-bot"}}
{ eventTime: "2026-03-18T03:04:09Z", eventName: "ReEncrypt", errorCode: "AccessDeniedException"}
```

aj: hmm, two things: we also pushed an RBAC tighten for scim-service principal yesterday that removed the kms:Decrypt permission for the old grant id. If alias switched to new key and the service doesn't have a grant on the new key, decryption will fail.

security-oncall: quick triage checklist:
- Verify alias -> key id mapping
- Check key policies and grants for scim-service principal
- If missing, create a grant that allows kms:Decrypt/kms:ReEncrypt for the service
- If time-critical, point alias back to previous key to restore decrypt ASAP

sam-sre: to create a grant:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-NEWKEY --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::1111:role/scim-service --operations Decrypt ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo
```

maria: creating grant now, applying to abcd-NEWKEY...
deploy-bot: deployment redeploy/scim-service @ 03:18 UTC — rolling restart triggered by maria

maria: OK created grant id: g-12345. scim-worker logs now show initial decrypts succeed.
```
2026-03-18T03:20:02Z INFO scim-worker KMS Decrypt succeeded for token blob
```

lina-sec: good. We should also backfill audit logs and create a short postmortem: root cause appears to be alias rotation + RBAC change removed service grants in same window.

aj: agreed — action items:
- add automated check in deploy pipeline to verify KMS grants when rotating aliases
- add runbook step: if alias update, create grant for service principal before switching
- add alert on "KMS Decrypt failed" spikes to eng-sre paging

maria: patching runbook now and opening PR for pipeline guard.

security-oncall: confirming incident resolved — SCIM provisioning recovered ~03:20 UTC, error rate back to baseline. Closing but moving to postmortem.

lina-sec: adding notes to incident tracker and tagging legal/compliance for audit export.

aj: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
